literal_meaning: বর্তমান অবস্থা এবং এখনকার সময় (হাল = বর্তমান অবস্থা, ফিল = এখন)
example_sentences_in_english: At present, the weather is very hot.
Currently, we are busy with this project.
history: Derived from Urdu 'hal-filhal', a common expression in South Asian languages indicating temporary present state, influenced by colonial-era linguistic exchanges.
note: This idiom is a direct borrowing and widely used in spoken and written Bengali without deep historical anecdotes.
